user_model_brief: Power-user SWE building Workbench (single-user personal intelligence feed). Picks maximal/ambitious options but wants HONEST data (no faked metrics). Design prefs: dark + orange Mission Control; Space Grotesk + Hanken Grotesk + JetBrains Mono (mono for all data); dense; tonal depth no shadows; 64px icon rail. Constraints: workbench public OSS (nothing in workbench-meta); preserve data wiring + a11y (AA) + five-state taxonomy; HashRouter; offline (no CDN); Make dev interface; real adapters only.
settled_decisions: Fidelity: faithful + wire new backend CASE-BY-CASE where the widget carries real signal; drop vanity/hollow widgets (active_sessions, unread pings, blocked tasks, kernel/arch/memory/network-latency); honest derivations (uptime->ingestion success rate, avg triage time from triage_cards).
Navigation: 64px icon rail + top app bar + working CmdK palette (server /api/search, cmdk).
Theme: dark default + KEEP light + theme toggle with auto/system mode (light ref = stitch-design-light.html).
Triage: combine variant-A 3-col shell + variant-B keyboard cards (preserves ADR0027).
Noise filter: build per-source relevance/noise thresholds for real (config + hot-reload).
Write paths: build Add-Action FAB (POST /api/actions) AND Add-Fact (manual fact distinct origin).
Work Mode: client-only localStorage visual focus (faithful to design JS); no notification muting.
Design source of truth: stitch-design.html (dark) + stitch-design-light.html (light), both gitignored; DESIGN-REFERENCE.md.
Two-orange system (#ff6a2b CTAs + #ffb59a text/icons); corrected surface ladder; hairline #26262C.
